galleryIntro: 5 external sounds with new native Stackr comparisons and your exact latest choice. An unchanged fully heard option set is omitted.
A small timing CNN trained on synthetic Stackr sequences chooses event boundaries. Compare it with the earlier waveform splitter; identical audio is merged.

Both use the same frozen synth-control experts and128 mutations per event. Different event counts mean different total work. Repeated development cases with historical Bfxr overlap; native timing accuracy does not establish audible likeness.
provenance.scope: Six repeated external references. Learned timing versus heuristic boundaries; fixed existing shared22/Transfxr control experts.128 mutations per event plus128 per timeline; differing counts mean unequal total work. Historical original-Bfxr overlap. No unseen-source or perceptual-improvement claim.
provenance.selectionPolicy: All six references, both scheduled fits and exact latest human winner. Merge exact PCM aliases; report all-identical trials without asking a one-option question.

publication.policy: Omit a trial only when the exact reference PCM and complete distinct option PCM set already occurred in a completed, fully auditioned retained trial. Do not filter on ratings, scores or which arm wins.

skippedAlreadyHeard.reason: Exact reference and all option PCM already judged and heard

likeness.meaning: Likeness to reference: 1 = far off, 5 = very close

usefulness.meaning: Useful/fun game sound: 1 = not useful, 5 = very useful or fun
